xrefs.text: Now Joshua was old and well along in years, and the LORD said to him, “You are old and well along in years, but very much of the land remains to be possessed.
And the LORD gave them rest on every side, just as He had sworn to their fathers. None of their enemies could stand against them, for the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

verses.text: Be very strong, then, so that you can keep and obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, not turning aside from it to the right or to the left.

xrefs.text: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them.

verses.text: So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.

xrefs.text: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips.
Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.

verses.text: Instead, you shall hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

xrefs.text: You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.
